import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features and target
X = train_df["text"].values
y = train_df["author"].values

# Split for validation (stratified to maintain class distribution)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Character-level TF-IDF with optimized n-gram ranges
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=15000, min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Fit vectorizer on training data only
X_train_tfidf = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"].values)

# Train LightGBM classifier with optimized parameters
lgbm = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=8,
    num_leaves=31,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)

# Train model
lgbm.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_preds = lgbm.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data for submission
X_full_tfidf = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X)
final_model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=8,
    num_leaves=31,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
final_model.fit(X_full_tfidf, y)

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission file
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["EAP"] = test_preds[:, 0]
submission["HPL"] = test_preds[:, 1]
submission["MWS"] = test_preds[:, 2]

# Ensure probabilities are in valid range and save
submission.iloc[:, 1:] = np.clip(submission.iloc[:, 1:], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
